comments.text:
Cory- you and the entire Monsters We Make team COOKED, brother.

I finally got my copy of MWM. I really wanted to wait until I had the physical copy to read it, and I’m really glad I did. From the moment I took it out of its packaging, you could tell the attention to detail, on all aspects, was next level!

As for Volume 1- I give it a 9/10. It’s hard to have the audience get a true understanding of each character’s nature through 8 chapters, but you were able to do that so well, AND give an incredibly flushed out world and setting.

I’m so excited to see where you take this story. I love the undertones of Christianity, as well as the darker undertones you’ve created. 

Praise Jesus and Keep GRINDING!!

Also.. WHEN this eventually gets green lit to gain an anime adaptation.. perhaps hit ya boy up for a shot at auditioning to be a VA?👀  I think I could bring a lot to the project.

comments.text: We got Markiplier making a tv show and a movie, we got jacksepticeye voice acting in a video game, and now we got an official Coryxkenshin made manga. I have no doubt this book sells incredibly well and I hope it will show corporations that quality and effort is what we the consumers look for. I've been a fan since the mkx days and it's been so amazing having you entertain me but also seeing you try new stuff and grow into the caring and creative person we all aspire to be like.
